title: (RHBA-2018:2358) rh-eclipse48 bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated rh-eclipse48 packages are now available as a part of Red Hat Developer Tools for Red Hat Enterprise Linux.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Workstation)|1|x86_64
Red Hat Developer Tools|Red Hat Developer Tools (for RHEL Server)|1|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The rh-eclipse48 packages include Eclipse 4.8, an integrated development environment (IDE), which is based on the Eclipse Foundation's Photon release train.

This update fixes the following bugs in Eclipse C/C++ Development Tooling (CDT):

* A potential thread deadlock at startup when Docker tooling is in use.
* A scaling issue and a concurrency issue with the code indexer.
* Inability to handle Docker images whose names contain slashes.

Users of rh-eclipse48 are advised to upgrade to these updated packages.

For instructions on how to use rh-eclipse48, see Using Eclipse linked from the References section.
